name: Onboarding
summary: Three shadcn-installable onboarding flows: a stepped form, a split-screen form and a checklist dialog.
description: A beUI Pro component page with three onboarding variants: onboarding-steps (numbered Interests - Skills - Documents stepper with grouped emoji chip selectors and a dashed upload step), onboarding-split (split-screen form beside an app-preview mock that live-binds the typed values) and onboarding-modal (progress-ring row that opens an animated checklist dialog). Each ships as a .tsx file installed with bunx shadcn add @beui-pro/onboarding-*.
contains: 3 variants: stepped, split screen and checklist dialog
shadcn registry items: onboarding-steps, onboarding-split, onboarding-modal
animated transitions, spring success state and live-bound form values
premium beUI Pro content (yearly or lifetime)
